fichas.title: Indoor Public Pool Diving Facilities
fichas.summary: Diving facilities for school and competitive sport include rigid platforms at 1, 3, 5 and 10 m and springboards at 1 and 3 m. Heights are measured from the water surface. Boards and platforms are reached by steep steps and are located on one side of the pool. Water rippling devices or sprinkler jets may improve divers’ visibility of the water surface. The safety-dimensions table specifies minimum clearances and water depths for different board and platform heights.
furniture_equipment: Rebounding springboards made of aluminium, wood or plastic
Water rippling devices or sprinkler jets

dimensions.ocr_raw:
SWIMMING POOLS
Indoor Public Pools
Diving facilities are used for school and competitive sport. Two
diving-off points are used: a rigid platform at heights of 1, 3, 5 and
10 m, and a rebounding springboard, made of aluminium, wood or
plastic, at heights of 1 and 3 m. The height of the diving positions
is measured from the water surface. The climb up to the board or
to the platform is up steep steps. All diving facilities are on one
side of the pool --) 0- f). Water temperature: 24-28 a c. In order
for divers to be able to discern the water surface better, water
rippling devices or sprinkler jets can be provided.
